body: FIFA 23 is a football video game published by EA Sports. It is the 30th and final installment in the FIFA series that is developed by EA Sports, and released worldwide on 30 September 2022 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and Stadia.
Kylian Mbappé and Sam Kerr are the cover athletes for the standard and legacy editions.

Listed in Guinness World Records as the best-selling sports video game franchise in the world, the game is the final under the 29-year partnership between EA and FIFA. Future football games by EA are named under the banner of EA Sports FC, beginning with EA Sports FC 24. The game's online servers shut down on October 30, 2025.

body: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative (  EYE) is a 2022 visual novel adventure video game developed and published by Spike Chunsoft. It is a sequel to AI: The Somnium Files (2019) and follows an older Mizuki Date alongside a new playable protagonist Kuruto Ryuki as they investigate the "Half-Body Murders". Gameplay is presented in both visual novel format and third-person exploration for dream investigation sequences.
Writer Kotaro Uchikoshi returns to script the game and reunites with character designer Yūsuke Kozaki, while the first game's designer and assistant director Akira Okada took over as director.
The game was released for the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One in June 2022 in Japan and North America, and July 2022 in Europe and Oceania.

body: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative (EYE) è un videogioco d’avventura in forma di visual novel del 2022, sviluppato e pubblicato da Spike Chunsoft. È il seguito di AI: The Somnium Files (2019) e segue una Mizuki Date più adulta insieme a un nuovo protagonista giocabile, Kuruto Ryuki, mentre indagano sugli «omicidi dei corpi dimezzati». Il gioco alterna il formato della visual novel all’esplorazione in terza persona nelle sequenze di indagine nei sogni.

Lo sceneggiatore Kotaro Uchikoshi torna a scrivere il gioco e a collaborare con il character designer Yūsuke Kozaki, mentre Akira Okada, designer e assistente alla regia del primo gioco, assume il ruolo di regista.
Il gioco è uscito per Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows e Xbox One nel giugno 2022 in Giappone e Nord America e nel luglio 2022 in Europa e Oceania.

body: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative (EYE) est un jeu vidéo d’aventure de type visual novel de 2022, développé et édité par Spike Chunsoft. Suite d’AI: The Somnium Files (2019), il suit une Mizuki Date plus âgée et un nouveau protagoniste jouable, Kuruto Ryuki, dans leur enquête sur les « meurtres des demi-corps ». Le jeu associe le format du visual novel à l’exploration à la troisième personne pendant les séquences d’enquête dans les rêves.
Le scénariste Kotaro Uchikoshi revient écrire le jeu et retrouve le créateur de personnages Yūsuke Kozaki, tandis qu’Akira Okada, concepteur et réalisateur adjoint du premier jeu, prend la direction.
Le jeu est sorti sur Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows et Xbox One en juin 2022 au Japon et en Amérique du Nord, puis en juillet 2022 en Europe et en Océanie.

body: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative (EYE) ist ein 2022 erschienenes Visual-Novel-Adventure, das von Spike Chunsoft entwickelt und veröffentlicht wurde. Es ist eine Fortsetzung von AI: The Somnium Files (2019) und folgt einer älteren Mizuki Date sowie dem neuen spielbaren Protagonisten Kuruto Ryuki bei ihren Ermittlungen zu den „Halbkörper-Morden“. Das Spiel verbindet das Visual-Novel-Format mit Erkundung aus der Third-Person-Perspektive in den Traumermittlungssequenzen.

Autor Kotaro Uchikoshi kehrt als Drehbuchautor zurück und arbeitet erneut mit Charakterdesigner Yūsuke Kozaki zusammen. Akira Okada, der Designer und stellvertretende Director des ersten Spiels, übernimmt die Leitung.
Das Spiel erschien für Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows und Xbox One im Juni 2022 in Japan und Nordamerika sowie im Juli 2022 in Europa und Ozeanien.
